## capturePng

[Implementation, line 22](../../../../src/render/capture.ts#L22)

Tiled PNG export using the renderer’s normal canvas antialiasing and tone mapping. Does not allocate a full-size GPU target or canvas.
The host freezes animation/scene edits and supplies its normal sky/scene pass.

```ts
capturePng(renderer: WebGLRenderer, camera: PerspectiveCamera, render: (tile: PerspectiveCamera) => void, options: { width: number height: number signal?: AbortSignal progress?: (fraction: number) => void }): Promise<Blob>
```
